How to help safeguard your child from human trafficking:
Know who your child knows, what they watch, and who they communicate with
Implement online safeguarding measures (e.g., charging your child's electronics outside of the bedroom overnight)
Foster a safe relationship with your child so they will come to you in uncomfortable situations
